result.title: On the Convergence of Success Conditioning for Policy Optimization
result.summary: Success conditioning is a strategy for improving decision-making policies in stochastic environments; it updates a policy by increasing the probability of taking actions that yield successful outcomes. Success conditioning is common to many reinforcement learning applications, yet its limiting behavior and convergence rates are not well understood. In this work, we demonstrate that success conditioning converges to an optimal policy on a broad class of Markov decision processes (MDPs). We also derive convergence rates in some common settings. For discounted MDPs, we prove convergence within $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$ iterations to an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy, where the exponent $p$ depends on problem data. For single-period MDPs, such a policy is obtained within $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文从理论上分析「成功条件化」策略优化方法，证明其在广泛 MDP 类上收敛到最优策略，并给出折扣 MDP 与单期 MDP 的迭代复杂度界。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯 RL 理论工作，但「成功条件化」的收敛性与迭代速率分析可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练、贡献分配与停止决策的监督信号设计提供收敛视角的借鉴线索，需人工核查其可迁移性。
